title: Union Budget net tax revenue
definition: Tax revenue retained by the Central Government net of states' share of Union taxes and duties.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
sources.title: Budget at a Glance 2026-2027

points.evidence: Page 1, Budget at a Glance table, row 'Tax Revenue (Net to Centre)': FY 2024-25 (Actuals) is 2500039 crore INR.
Page 1, Budget at a Glance table, row 'Tax Revenue (Net to Centre)': FY 2025-26 (Revised Estimates) is 2674661 crore INR.
points.estimate_method: Ministry of Finance Revised Estimates for FY 2025-26.

points.evidence: Page 1, Budget at a Glance table, row 'Tax Revenue (Net to Centre)': FY 2026-27 (Budget Estimates) is 2866922 crore INR.
